homeHeroDescription:
You can now choose:
journey through the Living Stories, explore the Review, or enter the creative space in your own turn.
homePrompt: Three paths, one shared attention to what may become alive.
libraryHeroSignature: Living Stories are not only stories to read. They are worlds to explore, passages to cross, and experiences that invite each person to inhabit reality differently.
libraryHeroDescription: Each work is an entryway. Each pack is a path. Each card becomes a landmark. Together, these journeys compose a living narrative territory that everyone can cross at their own pace.
libraryDescription: Choose an entryway. Each journey opens a different way to explore the Living Stories.
workshopsDescription: These workshops offer guided paths for exploring different ways of creating with artificial intelligence. AI becomes a partner for exploration without taking the place of the creator’s perspective, choices or creative gesture. Some workshops are already available; others will gradually enrich this space.
reviewDescription: A narrative ecology review for exploring the questions, tensions, and shifts that transform the way we see.
workshopEntryIntro:
Here, AI does not write in your place.

It appears at specific moments to open directions, shift your perspective, surface questions, or test a transformation.

You remain the one who chooses, writes, revises, refuses, and decides when to stop.
workshopEntryPrivacy: Your progress and responses are stored locally in this browser while its site data is kept. They are not synchronized across devices. AI prompts are copied manually into the assistant of your choice.
workshopParticipationTitle: How do I take part in an Augmented Workshop?
workshopParticipationPaceTitle: A journey at your own pace
workshopParticipationPaceText: Each workshop has 7 movements and 26 steps. Exchanges with AI are occasional and optional: you can complete the whole workshop without using AI.
workshopParticipationChoiceTitle: Which conversational AI should I choose?
workshopParticipationChoiceText: You are free to use ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, or another compatible conversational assistant. An existing subscription may be enough; a free offer can also help you get started. Limits on interactions, models, and features vary by service and may change.
workshopParticipationHowText: Open the workshop and your assistant in two tabs, windows, or apps. When an invitation appears, copy the prompt, replace bracketed instructions with your own material, send it to the assistant, freely examine the response, then return to the workshop. On a phone, simply switch between tabs or apps.
workshopParticipationKeepTitle: What should I keep from AI responses?
workshopParticipationKeepText: You do not have to keep everything. Note ideas, questions, wording, objections, refusals, or directions that are useful to you. Do not share sensitive personal data with an external assistant without understanding its privacy implications.
workshopParticipationChangeText: Yes. Prompts can be copied into different assistants. In a new conversation, provide the context requested by the prompt: an assistant does not automatically know your earlier exchanges.
workshopParticipationResumeTitle: How can I return to my workshop?
workshopParticipationResumeText: Your responses and progress are stored in this browser, on this device, while site data is kept. They are not synchronized across devices or browsers and may be lost if site data is cleared, in private browsing, or if storage becomes unavailable. Keep a personal copy of important writing and decisions.
workshopParticipationFreedomText: You may use AI or choose not to use it. If you do, you may welcome, transform, challenge, or reject its suggestions, stop the dialogue, revisit a choice, or stop altogether. AI supports the exploration of possibilities; it does not decide for you.
workshopEntryRestartDescription: Your current progress and saved responses for this workshop will be removed from this browser. This action cannot be undone.
workshopUnsupportedBlock: This interaction will be available in a future engine step.
workshopPromptCopyFailure: Automatic copy did not work. The prompt remains available for manual copying.
workshopPromptOptional: This invitation to AI is optional. You can copy this prompt into the assistant of your choice, or continue without using it.
workshopPromptPlaceholderHelp: Replace the instructions in brackets with your own material before sending the prompt.
workshopRecallEmptyText: No response was written at this step.
